commands.purpose: Generate a directive resolver skeleton for a directive defined in the configured GraphQL SDL.
recommended_when: Adding support for an executable GraphQL directive.
Need to scaffold a directive resolver class from schema SDL.
avoid_when: Running inside this repository without a consumer app.
The target directive is not present in the configured schema.
commands.expected_outcome: Writes generated directive resolver file(s) and prints filenames; returns failure if the directive is missing.

commands.purpose: Generate field resolver skeleton file(s) for a specific object type field from schema SDL.
recommended_when: Adding custom behavior for one GraphQL object field.
Need a resolver scaffold matching schema-defined type and field names.
avoid_when: Running inside this repository without a consumer app.
The target type or field does not exist in SDL.
commands.expected_outcome: Writes generated field resolver file(s) and prints filenames; returns failure when the type or field is missing.

commands.purpose: Generate a custom scalar resolver for a scalar defined in schema SDL.
recommended_when: Adding a custom scalar to the schema.
Need scalar resolver scaffold from existing SDL.
avoid_when: Running inside this repository without a consumer app.
The named scalar is not present in SDL.
commands.expected_outcome: Writes generated scalar resolver file and prints filename; returns failure when the scalar is missing.

commands.purpose: Generate all type classes and the TypeRegistry class from the configured schema SDL.
recommended_when: Refreshing generated GraphQL code without invoking cache:clear.
Validating generation for all schema types.
avoid_when: Running inside this repository without a consumer app.
The host app has not configured flexible_graphql yet.
commands.expected_outcome: Generates all type code, writes the TypeRegistry class file, and prints output filenames.

commands.purpose: Recommended consumer-app path to regenerate GraphQL artifacts through the registered cache warmer.
requires_services: Host Symfony app using this bundle
Bundle registered in the host app
recommended_when: Need generated code refreshed during Symfony cache warm.
avoid_when: Running in this repository without a host app.
commands.expected_outcome: Symfony cache clear triggers SchemaCacheWarmer and refreshes generated GraphQL artifacts in the consumer target directory.

commands.purpose: List the flexible_graphql console commands exposed by the bundle in a consumer app.
recommended_when: Verifying command namespace registration in a consumer app.
avoid_when: Running in this repository without a host app.
commands.expected_outcome: Displays the flexible_graphql command namespace and registered commands in the host Symfony console.

commands.purpose: Install PHP dependencies declared by composer.json for local inspection or development of the bundle.
recommended_when: Preparing a local environment for repository development.
Need package versions available under vendor/.
avoid_when: A read-only review is sufficient and vendor/ is not needed.
commands.expected_outcome: Installs Symfony and GraphQL PHP dependencies under vendor/ according to composer.json.
